name: Student Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Guide visitors and school tour groups through the music museum as a guide in one of several gallery roles. Training is provided.
who_can_apply: High school and college students 16 and older. Parent or guardian consent is needed under 18.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Student volunteers do not need a museum membership.
duration: Summer: one full month, at least 2 shifts a week. Year-round: at least 2 shifts a month.
deadline_text: No other deadline stated. The fall 2026 Museum Guide deadline of Sept 25, 2026 has passed.
how_to_apply: Send in the Student form on the page. Meet the volunteer team. Pass a background check and drug test. Then finish orientation and training. Call 480.245.6915 or email volunteer@MIM.org.
notes: Museum is at 4725 E. Mayo Blvd., Phoenix. The background check and drug test are required.
